seismic_scan.text: Hold Scan beside the valley to trace the living roots.
seismic_scan.sarathi: Hold Scan beside the valley to trace the roots beneath our drills.

move_drills.text: Move every drill clear of the marked roots.
move_drills.sarathi: Move every drill away from the marked roots so they have room to settle.

bio_filters_valley.text: Keep working bio-filters near the smog until the haze clears.
bio_filters_valley.sarathi: Supply bio-filters near the smog with water and power until the haze clears.

replant_bloom.text: Replant bloom spores around Mooladri's exposed roots once the soil is clean.
replant_bloom.sarathi: Replant bloom spores around the exposed roots once the soil is clean, then give the new growth time to settle.
